prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: editable production bitmap resource atlas for a football management game's compact dropdown controls.
Create exactly THREE separate blank horizontal control plates stacked in three equally sized rows on a genuinely transparent square 1024x1024 canvas. One complete plate in each row, centered with generous transparent gutters. Each plate is about 864px wide and 240px high, with identical clean rounded-rectangle or clipped-corner geometry appropriate to the theme. The plates must be opaque inside and transparent only outside. They will become nine-slice UI resources: keep corners and edge decoration within a small constant-width perimeter, and keep the middle large, quiet and stretchable.
Top plate: the closed dropdown trigger, a subtle refined editable-field surface.
Middle plate: the floating dropdown popup's outer plate, with a restrained thin perimeter and a very subtle sense of lift.
Bottom plate: the selected option row, a restrained inset highlight with a slightly warmer or brighter centre, not a primary-action button.
Critical design direction: elegant, thin, low-profile framing, refined small corner details and beautiful restrained material. Match the theme's other UI. Avoid thick outlines, double or triple rims, heavy bevels, oversized corners, noisy decorations and bulky puffy buttons. The resource must remain beautiful when the full visible control is only 36px high.
No text, letters, numbers, glyphs, arrow icons, checkmarks, labels, logos or watermark. Do not draw whole menus, example UI, multiple options, layout containers or a mockup. Draw only these three blank reusable plates. Do not connect the plates. Actual labels and arrows will be live content rendered separately. Preserve genuine alpha gutters, no checkerboard background.
Theme identity: Stadium Green, a sophisticated forest-green European football management UI, matte painted surfaces with gentle fine pigment texture, quiet rounded corners and low-key sage edges. Top: deep muted forest-green field with a single fine sage-green keyline. Middle: slightly lighter dark forest-green floating plate, with a very thin sage rim and restrained depth. Bottom: soft pale sage green with a fine darker green edge, clear enough for dark-green text. Natural, restrained, professional; no wood grain, no paper distress, no sticker rim, no glossy 3D bevels.
